cds.title: Central Connecticut State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (XLSX)

navigator.title: College Navigator profile, Central Connecticut State University (student-to-faculty ratio, setting)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025): international first-year applicants 390, admitted 70 (18%), enrolled 10, far below the 79% overall admit rate, so international applicants are not near-certain admits. No waitlist, no early decision or early action. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (average 3.15 on a 4.0 scale, reported by 98%). SAT percentiles are of the 751 enrolled first-years who submitted SAT; ACT is reported by only 6 students so ACT percentiles are omitted. Undergraduate enrollment 9,463 is CDS B1 and the 164 nonresident undergraduates are CDS B2 (156 degree-seeking). Student-to-faculty ratio 14:1 is College Navigator.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (fall 2027 applicants): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (2026-27): tuition in-state $6,998, out-of-state (New England/NEBHE rate) $10,498, nonresident $20,938; required fees $6,052; on-campus food and housing $13,472. The admissions-site tuition page lists an international full-time rate of $13,455 per term ($26,910 a year, tuition plus fees), within $80 of CDS nonresident tuition plus fees. Other = transportation $672 plus other expenses $1,589 (G5, residents). H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 115 nonresident undergraduates received it, averaging $9,918.
